events.verdict: Mann (LAC) is moving forward as he trails Dick (TOR) over the hand-off and marginal body contact occurs as Dick makes the pass.
Mann (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Dick (TOR) as Dick releases the pass.
Boucher (TOR) makes clean forearm contact with the ball and dislodges it from Zubac (LAC) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Boucher (TOR) bats the ball in an attempt to gain control of it, and ultimately gathers the loose ball in his left hand, and then legally starts his dribble.
Jones Jr. (LAC) maintains a rested hand on Boucher's (TOR) side and does not apply any force as Boucher elevates for the layup attempt.
Quickley (TOR) maintains a rested hand on Harden's (LAC) right side and does not apply any force as Harden elevates for the driving shot attempt.

Harden's (LAC) off-arm is brought outward slightly after he releases the shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with Fernando's (TOR) face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.

Quickley (TOR) brings the ball up into Zubac's (LAC) right knee and Zubac does not make intentional foot-to-ball contact. A timeout is initially called by Los Angeles to challenge the play, but given that this play is not reviewable, the timeout request was rescinded by Los Angeles and ultimately not awarded.
Harden (LAC) and Agbaji (TOR) engage and disengage with one another prior to and as Agbaji sets the screen.
Fernando (TOR) establishes a screening position in Harden's (LAC) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Agbaji (TOR) extends his right hand forward and initiates contact with Powell's (LAC) right arm, causing Powell to lose control of it after his gather.
Mann (LAC) brings his hands toward Quickley's (TOR) path and Quickley is able to move through the marginal contact to progress inside the perimeter.
Mann (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Quickley's (TOR) path and marginal contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Fernando (TOR) jumps into Harden (LAC) and initiates body contact that causes Harden to become dislodged during the rebound.
Mann (LAC) is established in Barrett's (TOR) path and absorbs the incidental body contact that occurs as the two come together in the lane.
Mann (LAC) is defending alongside Barrett's (TOR) path and marginal body contact occurs after Barrett's gather.
Agbaji (TOR) makes initial contact with the ball prior to further marginal contact occurring with Powell's (LAC) right shoulder as Powell secures the rebound.
Quickley (TOR) commits a take foul on Powell (LAC).
Harden (LAC) commits a take foul on Poltl (TOR).
As Jones Jr. (LAC) is moving toward Poltl (TOR), Poltl releases his right arm away from Jones Jr.'s front and marginal contact occurs as the two come together during the inbound.
Poltl (TOR) crosses the plane of the free throw line prior to the ball entering the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Jones Jr. (LAC) commits a take foul on P?ltl (TOR).

As the ball ricochets off of the rim, Fernando (TOR) raises both hands up as he mistimes his jump for the rebound and marginal contact occurs with Zubac's (LAC) head and right shoulder. Fernando then makes further incidental contact with Zubac's left arm thereafter. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Fernando (TOR) steps forward prior to marginal contact occurring with Zubac's (LAC) lower body after he secures the rebound.
Zubac (LAC) stays in bounds prior to releasing the pass.
